notes: Author page 13, archive folio 90. The opening discussion adds a quotient-descent requirement formulated using stability of a kernel. A second paragraph asks for a lift of the Θ action. The lemma begins with connected groupoids and an injectivity hypothesis, and stops at quand-même que without a completed sentence.

All tokens in both native halves were collated against the ink, including C/H agreements. The three mathematical displays were inspected for letters, hats, subscripts, inclusion, arrow directions and punctuation. Both map arrows have visible rightward heads; no arrow ambiguity is transferred from them to the lemma's joining sign.

The underlines belong to un and Lemme. The stroke below de plus is an insertion connector. The deletion before Θ leaves Θ live. The mark before de sorte remains explicitly ambiguous between a cancelled et and an opening parenthesis.

No mathematical proposition was independently proved or used to decide the ink. The groupoid and kernel statements above are manuscript synopsis only; check_events is empty. In particular, the morphism context did not decide the ambiguous lemma arrow.
Whole page viewed once; each supplied native half once; seven focused crops, each once and all rotation 0. H's editorial comments about other pages were not used to inspect or infer their contents.
The acute-like tick in d\unsure{é|e} is retained as uncertainty even though ordinary grammar would favor de; grammar does not erase the visible stroke.
